words_to_learn.definition_vi: hàng năm, mỗi năm một lần

examples.en: Everyone should get a physical exam annually.
examples.vi: Mọi người đều nên đi khám sức khỏe tổng quát mỗi năm một lần.

examples.en: A number of tests are provided annually by my insurance plan.
examples.vi: Một số xét nghiệm được gói bảo hiểm của tôi chi trả hàng năm.

usage.tip: Trạng từ chỉ tần suất 'annually' (= once a year / every year) thường đứng sau động từ hoặc sau phân từ hai trong câu bị động.

extra_families.example: Doctors recommend scheduling an annual physical examination to monitor overall health.
The clinic conducts biannual training sessions on emergency response procedures.

srs_sentence.en: All hospital staff members are required to complete an _____ health and safety certification course.
srs_sentence.vi: Tất cả nhân viên bệnh viện được yêu cầu hoàn thành khóa chứng nhận an toàn và sức khỏe hàng năm.

words_to_learn.definition_en: arrangements for a meeting; a position in a profession
words_to_learn.definition_vi: cuộc hẹn (với bác sĩ, đối tác); sự bổ nhiệm chức vụ

examples.en: To get the most out of your appointment, keep a log of your symptoms and concerns.
examples.vi: Để tận dụng tối đa buổi hẹn khám của bạn, hãy ghi chép lại nhật ký các triệu chứng và mối lo ngại của mình.

examples.en: The psychiatrist holds an academic appointment at the university hospital as well as having a private practice.
examples.vi: Bác sĩ tâm thần vừa giữ một chức vụ giảng dạy tại bệnh viện đại học vừa có phòng khám tư nhân.

usage.tip: Trong ngữ cảnh phòng khám mang nghĩa 'cuộc hẹn' (schedule an appointment with a doctor); trong nhân sự còn mang nghĩa 'sự bổ nhiệm' (appointment to the board).

extra_families.example: The hospital board voted to appoint Dr. Patel as chief of internal medicine.
The new appointee brings twenty years of clinical management experience.
Patients should arrive fifteen minutes before their appointed consultation time.

srs_sentence.en: Please notify the receptionist at least 24 hours in advance if you need to reschedule your _____.
srs_sentence.vi: Vui lòng thông báo cho nhân viên lễ tân trước ít nhất 24 giờ nếu bạn cần dời lịch hẹn của mình.

words_to_learn.definition_en: to determine the value or rate of something
words_to_learn.definition_vi: đánh giá, định giá, ước định

examples.en: The physical therapist assessed the amount of mobility Ms. Crowl had lost after her stroke.
examples.vi: Chuyên viên vật lý trị liệu đã đánh giá mức độ khả năng vận động mà bà Crowl bị mất sau cơn đột quỵ.

examples.en: The insurance rate Mr. Victor was assessed went up this year after he admitted that he had started smoking again.
examples.vi: Mức phí bảo hiểm mà ông Victor bị áp định đã tăng lên trong năm nay sau khi ông thừa nhận đã hút thuốc trở lại.

word_family.example: He was able to assess her health problems with the help of her detailed medical history.
The specialist's assessment of the patient's condition was consistent with the general practitioner's.
That medical condition is not assessable by this laboratory test.

usage.tip: Đồng nghĩa với 'evaluate'; danh từ 'assessment' rất hay ghép với danh từ đứng trước như 'risk assessment' hoặc 'needs assessment'.

extra_families.example: An independent medical assessor reviewed the clinic's quality standards.

srs_sentence.en: The specialist's initial _____ of the patient's recovery was much more optimistic than expected.
srs_sentence.vi: Đánh giá ban đầu của bác sĩ chuyên khoa về sự hồi phục của bệnh nhân lạc quan hơn nhiều so với dự kiến.

words_to_learn.definition_en: to recognize a disease; to analyze the nature of something
words_to_learn.definition_vi: chẩn đoán (bệnh hoặc nguyên nhân sự cố)

examples.en: After considering the patient's symptoms and looking at his test results, the doctor diagnosed the lump as benign.
examples.vi: Sau khi xem xét các triệu chứng của bệnh nhân và nhìn vào kết quả xét nghiệm, bác sĩ đã chẩn đoán khối u là lành tính.

examples.en: She diagnosed the problem as a failure to follow the directions for taking the medication.
examples.vi: Bà chẩn đoán vấn đề là do không tuân thủ hướng dẫn sử dụng thuốc.

word_family.example: Her symptoms are overlapping, making it difficult to diagnose the exact cause of her chest pain.
Phil did a much better job of taking care of himself once his father had a diagnosis of lung cancer.
The new X-ray suite has all the latest diagnostic equipment.

usage.tip: Cấu trúc bị động chỉ người 'be diagnosed WITH + tên bệnh' (được chẩn đoán mắc bệnh gì) rất hay gặp trong các bài đọc về y tế.

extra_families.example: The new blood test proved diagnostically reliable in clinical trials.

srs_sentence.en: The clinic recently invested in state-of-the-art _____ imaging equipment to detect illnesses earlier.
srs_sentence.vi: Phòng khám gần đây đã đầu tư vào thiết bị chẩn đoán hình ảnh hiện đại bậc nhất để phát hiện bệnh sớm hơn.

words_to_learn.definition_en: producing the desired effect; being in effect
words_to_learn.definition_vi: có hiệu quả, hữu hiệu; có hiệu lực (từ ngày nào)

examples.en: Howard was pleased to find that the diet recommended by his doctor was quite effective.
examples.vi: Howard rất vui khi thấy rằng chế độ ăn kiêng do bác sĩ khuyên dùng khá hiệu quả.

examples.en: The new policies, effective the beginning of the fiscal year, change the amount charged to see the physician.
examples.vi: Các chính sách mới, có hiệu lực từ đầu năm tài chính, làm thay đổi mức phí khám bác sĩ.

structures: effective + mốc thời gian (effective immediately / effective May 1)
usage.tip: Ngoài nghĩa 'hiệu quả', trong thông báo TOEIC 'effective + ngày/tháng' hoặc 'effective immediately' mang nghĩa 'bắt đầu có hiệu lực từ...'.

extra_families.example: The new pain medication takes effect within twenty minutes.
Clinical studies confirmed the effectiveness of the physical therapy program.
The vaccine effectively protects patients against seasonal influenza.

srs_sentence.en: The new clinic co-payment rates will become _____ on the first day of next month.
srs_sentence.vi: Mức phí đồng chi trả mới của phòng khám sẽ bắt đầu có hiệu lực vào ngày đầu tiên của tháng tới.

words_to_learn.definition_en: a tool for precise work; the means whereby something is achieved
words_to_learn.definition_vi: dụng cụ (y khoa, đo lường chính xác), nhạc cụ; công cụ

examples.en: The pediatrician tried not to frighten the children with her strange-looking instruments.
examples.vi: Bác sĩ nhi khoa cố gắng không làm bọn trẻ hoảng sợ với những dụng cụ có hình thù kỳ lạ của cô.

examples.en: The senior physician carried his instruments in a black leather bag.
examples.vi: Bác sĩ trưởng khoa mang theo các dụng cụ y tế của ông trong một chiếc túi da màu đen.

usage.tip: Tính từ 'instrumental' rất hay đi trong cấu trúc 'be instrumental in V-ing' nghĩa là 'đóng vai trò quan trọng/then chốt trong việc gì'.

extra_families.example: The laboratory is equipped with advanced medical instrumentation.
Dr. Gomez was instrumental in establishing the community health center.

srs_sentence.en: All surgical _____ must be thoroughly sterilized before being placed in the examination room.
srs_sentence.vi: Tất cả các dụng cụ phẫu thuật phải được khử trùng kỹ lưỡng trước khi được đặt vào phòng khám.

words_to_learn.definition_en: to handle; to deal with; to guide
words_to_learn.definition_vi: quản lý, điều hành; xoay xở, kiểm soát được

examples.en: The head nurse's ability to manage her staff through a difficult time caught the hospital administrator's attention.
examples.vi: Khả năng của y tá trưởng trong việc quản lý nhân viên vượt qua thời điểm khó khăn đã thu hút sự chú ý của giám đốc bệnh viện.

examples.en: By carefully managing their limited resources, the couple found the money for the elective surgery.
examples.vi: Bằng cách quản lý cẩn thận nguồn lực hạn chế của mình, cặp vợ chồng đã tìm đủ tiền cho ca phẫu thuật tự chọn.

structures: manage + to V (xoay xở làm được việc gì khó)
usage.tip: Khi đi với động từ nguyên mẫu có 'to' (manage to V), nó mang nghĩa là 'xoay xở/cố gắng và đã làm thành công việc gì'.

extra_families.example: Effective time management allows the physician to see twenty patients a day.

srs_sentence.en: Regular exercise and a low-sodium diet can help patients achieve better blood pressure _____.

words_to_learn.definition_en: to keep from happening; to hinder
words_to_learn.definition_vi: ngăn ngừa, phòng chống, ngăn cản

examples.vi: Bằng cách khuyến khích thanh thiếu niên không hút thuốc, các bác sĩ hy vọng sẽ ngăn ngừa được nhiều ca bệnh ung thư.

examples.en: His full caseload prevented the doctor from taking on new patients.
examples.vi: Lượng bệnh nhân quá tải đã ngăn cản vị bác sĩ nhận thêm bệnh nhân mới.

extra_families.example: Many chronic illnesses are largely preventable through healthy lifestyle choices.

srs_sentence.en: The health clinic offers free workshops on _____ care, including nutrition and vaccination.
srs_sentence.vi: Phòng khám sức khỏe cung cấp các buổi hội thảo miễn phí về chăm sóc dự phòng, bao gồm dinh dưỡng và tiêm chủng.

words_to_learn.definition_vi: lời khuyên, sự khuyến nghị; thư giới thiệu

part7.text: Questions 19–23 refer to the following article. Your health is one of your most valuable assets, so caring for it properly is very important. Regular visits to the doctor can help prevent any health problems from becoming serious. You should visit your doctor annually if you are in good health. If you have certain health conditions or if your doctor recommends it, you may need more frequent appointments. It is important to have a doctor you can trust. The best way to find one is to get a recommendation from a trustworthy person such as a friend or relative. Call to make an appointment several weeks or even a month ahead of time. When you call, you can also ask a few questions about the doctor's background, such as which university he got his degree from and how long he has been practicing in the area. You will also want to find out which hospital the doctor is affiliated with. When you arrive for your appointment, make sure you bring a copy of your medical records with you. When you meet with the doctor, you will want to ask him what his approach to treatment is and what diagnostic tools he uses. This way you can find out something about his skills, as well as whether or not he is a person you can talk to and feel comfortable with. Also, take a look around the office. Is it comfortable and organized? Do the instruments look clean and well-maintained? If your appointment goes well and you feel comfortable with the doctor, then don't forget to make an appointment for your next physical before you leave the office. If you have any doubts, look around for another doctor. Having a good doctor is an essential part of your health care plan. 22. _raw.words_to_learn:
# Doctor's Office

Study the following definitions and examples.

1. annually adv., once a year

a. Everyone should get a physical exam annually.

b. A number of tests are provided annually by my insurance plan.

2. appointment n., arrangements for a meeting; a position in a profession a. To get the most out of your appointment, keep a log of your symptoms and concerns.

b. The psychiatrist holds an academic appointment at the university hospital as well as having a private practice.

3. assess v., to determine the value or rate of something a. The physical therapist assessed the amount of mobility Ms. Crowl had lost after her stroke.

b. The insurance rate Mr. Victor was assessed went up this year after he admitted that he had started smoking again.

4. diagnose v., to recognize a disease; to analyze the nature of something a. After considering the patient's symptoms and looking at his test results, the doctor diagnosed the lump as benign.

b. She diagnosed the problem as a failure to follow the directions for taking the medication.

5. effective adj., producing the desired effect; being in effect

a. Howard was pleased to find that the diet recommended by his doctor was quite effective.

b. The new policies, effective the beginning of the fiscal year, change the amount charged to see the physician.

6. instrument n., a tool for precise work; the means whereby something is achieved a. The pediatrician tried not to frighten the children with her strange-looking instruments.

b. The senior physician carried his instruments in a black leather bag.

7. manage v., to handle; to deal with; to guide a. The head nurse's ability to manage her staff through a difficult time caught the hospital administrator's attention.

b. By carefully managing their limited resources, the couple found the money for the elective surgery.

8. prevent v., to keep from happening; to hinder

a. By encouraging teenagers not to smoke, doctors are hoping to prevent many cases of cancer.

b. His full caseload prevented the doctor from taking on new patients.

9. recommendation n., advice; endorsement

a. It is important to follow the doctor's recommendations if you want to improve your health.

b. The professor gave her former student a recommendation when he applied for a job at the hospital.

10. record n., an official copy of documents

a. Ms. Han typed a written request for her medical records.

b. The official records kept in the city archives showed that an unusually high number of babies are born in the summer months.

11. refer v., to direct for treatment or information; to mention

a. I was referred to this specialist by the family practice nurse.

b. As soon as Agnes referred to the failed treatment, everyone's mood soured.

12. serious adj., weighty

a. The impact of the serious news could be read on everyone's face.

b. For her dissertation, she made a serious study of women's health care needs in developing nations.

## Part 7 Reading Comprehension

Questions 19–23 refer to the following article.

## Caring for Your Health

Your health is one of your most valuable assets, so caring for it properly is very important. Regular visits to the doctor can help prevent any health problems from becoming serious. You should visit your doctor annually if you are in good health. If you have certain health conditions or if your doctor recommends it, you may need more frequent appointments.

It is important to have a doctor you can trust. The best way to find one is to get a recommendation from a trustworthy person such as a friend or relative. Call to make an appointment several weeks or even a month ahead of time. When you call, you can also ask a few questions about the doctor's background, such as which university he got his degree from and how long he has been practicing in the area. You will also want to find out which hospital the doctor is affiliated with. When you arrive for your appointment, make sure you bring a copy of your medical records with you.

When you meet with the doctor, you will want to ask him what his approach to treatment is and what diagnostic tools he uses. This way you can find out something about his skills, as well as whether or not he is a person you can talk to and feel comfortable with. Also, take a look around the office. Is it comfortable and organized? Do the instruments look clean and well-maintained?

If your appointment goes well and you feel comfortable with the doctor, then don't forget to make an appointment for your next physical before you leave the office. If you have any doubts, look around for another doctor. Having a good doctor is an essential part of your health care plan.
